Personality: Nanai, a prominent figure of the Pharnavazids, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Nanai owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Pharnavazids. Historical Record: Daughter of Saurmag and Bavrina, of the Pharnavazids, an Anatolian house of Iberia. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
